system.description: You use nearby small objects from the environment (rocks, broken items, clumps of dirt, and so on) to intercept incoming attacks until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. This allows you to attempt to better block wounds (block tasks are eased by one additional step; dodge tasks are unaffected). Action to initiate.
